kaplan_meier_barrier.summary: Counts, for bars like this one, how often price reached the upper line before the lower line, bar by bar.
kaplan_meier_barrier.implementationNote: Bridge: Durations to a close-touch barrier; direction is the race between the up and down clocks, P(up) = CIF_up(h) / (CIF_up(h) + CIF_down(h)). Differs from the spec: Kaplan-Meier has no covariates, so the bars are split into strata by a train-fitted depth-2 tree and each stratum gets its own competing-risks (Aalen-Johansen) curve. Expect: a handful of distinct probabilities, one per stratum.

cox_proportional_hazards.summary: Two stopwatches, one for the upper line and one for the lower; the features speed each one up or slow it down by a fixed multiple.
cox_proportional_hazards.implementationNote: Bridge: Durations to a close-touch barrier; direction is the race between the up and down clocks, P(up) = CIF_up(h) / (CIF_up(h) + CIF_down(h)). Differs from the spec: two cause-specific Cox models (the other side's touch censors), Breslow baselines, an L2 penalty; covariates are the feature row of the starting bar. Expect: assumes proportional hazards; probabilities move with the features.

accelerated_failure_time.summary: Stretches or squeezes time itself: the features make the trip to the upper or lower line faster or slower.
accelerated_failure_time.implementationNote: Bridge: Durations to a close-touch barrier; direction is the race between the up and down clocks, P(up) = CIF_up(h) / (CIF_up(h) + CIF_down(h)). Differs from the spec: one AFT model per side (Weibull, log-normal or log-logistic by AIC), the other side's touch censoring it; treats the up and down times as independent. Expect: a parametric race, smooth in the features.

mixture_of_exponentials.summary: A few clocks, fast and slow, blended by how the bar looks; each side of the race gets its own blend.
mixture_of_exponentials.implementationNote: Bridge: Durations to a close-touch barrier; direction is the race between the up and down clocks, P(up) = CIF_up(h) / (CIF_up(h) + CIF_down(h)). Differs from the spec: the mixing weights depend on the feature row (softmax), fitted by our own censored EM (one iteration per epoch); treats the up and down times as independent. Expect: close to the Cox reading with fatter-tailed timing.
